title: AAPSClient missing entries from AAPS
symptom: Treatments entered by AAPS (carbs and boluses) are not reflected on AAPSClient, despite websockets being ON on both devices. Other users report similar issues with treatments not appearing or not being taken into account, and profile sync problems.
cause: The thread does not definitively identify a root cause. It suggests possible websocket reconnection issues and notes that the issue has been improved in later versions.
fix: The thread indicates that the issue has been improved in later versions (dev-i and later). A user reported that restarting Heroku dynos and performing a full sync from AAPS fixed profile sync issues. No specific configuration change is provided.
evidence_quote: this has been improved. open new issue if this re-appear
